findings.detail: The B01 leaf universe appears to include both the September 30, 2025 SOI and the December 31, 2024 comparative SOI; the raw source has separate current and comparative totals, while only 216 of 431 counted leaves carry fair_value.

rationale: B01 is a Class 3 aggregate completeness flag with no single row specified. The raw source shows a current-period SOI total at table 11 row 29 of fair value 7,724,072 and a separate comparative-period SOI total at table 17 row 30 of fair value 7,244,282. The failing universe, 216/431 leaves with fair_value, is approximately the current-period leaf count over current plus comparative leaves, so the source supports a comparative-period leakage/counting defect rather than missing disclosure. Source rows themselves carry fair-value columns.
